clean_source_blocks.text: The school district, which serves about half a million students, is looking to reduce its reliance on devices after the pandemic.
It comes as the district, which serves about half ​a million students, sought to reduce its reliance on tablets and laptops, which was prompted by the Covid-19 pandemic.
The district, which serves about half a ​million students, ​has relied heavily on laptops and tablets ​since the coronavirus pandemic of ‌2020 accelerated digital learning.

The school board of the nation's second-largest school district approved the measure by a ​6-0 vote with one recusal, making the Los Angeles Unified School District among the first in the nation to create systemwide, grade-by-grade limits on classroom screen time.
